usereventscript.description: Blocks item receipts from an Inbound Shipment that is not ready to be received (landed cost, customs number, customs segment on every line, lot = pedimento). Runs in ALL execution contexts.
usereventscript.name: ACME - Item Receipt gate

scriptcustomfield.label: Gate: enforce landed cost loaded
scriptcustomfield.description: Unchecked = warn-only (audit log), no block. Changing this in production is a controlled change: it is how goods enter without landed cost.

scriptcustomfield.label: Gate: enforce customs number + segment (header and lines)
Gate: enforce lot = customs number (MX pedimento)
scriptcustomfield.description: Unchecked = warn-only (audit log), no block. The MX localization bundle resolves the CFDI pedimento by item + location + lot, so the lot received must be the pedimento.

scriptcustomfield.label: Gate: subsidiaries where lot = customs number applies (ids, comma-separated; blank = all)
scriptcustomfield.description: Set to the internal id of Andina MX so AR/CO receipts (customs segment only) are not subject to the lot rule.

scriptcustomfield.label: Gate: regex the customs number must match (blank = no format check)
scriptcustomfield.description: Spaces are removed before matching. Default = Mexican pedimento (15 digits).

scriptcustomfield.label: Gate: LC Status 'Confirmed' internal id
scriptcustomfield.description: Verify the id in each account (sandbox ids can differ). If blank the gate blocks every receipt (fail closed).
